label: Episode 14
title: How Did We Get Here? The Rise of Obesity in the UK
subtitle: The rise of obesity in the UK

quotes.text: Managing obesity is not just an issue of how you look, it's an issue of how you're going to live and how well you're going to live and how long you're going to live.
Obesity is now probably the biggest driver of ill health and future disease in the population.
Childhood obesity is the elephant in the room in terms of the future risks to the population.
We have to treat health in the way in which we think about investing in our finances.
We want to live longer, but we want to live longer well.
